answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the oasis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the reef of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
